title: Child in Chair Outdoors, 1951 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century vintage black and white snapshot captured in May 1951 depicting a joyous young child kicking their legs while sitting in a folding high chair in an open dirt yard. The photographer's shadow looms large in the foreground, creating a candid family moment. A vintage toy pedal car sits parked near a tree in the background alongside utility poles under a bright, sunny sky.
